scripts.dev:phone: concurrently -k -n APP,TUNNEL -c blue,green "npm run dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000" "env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u ALL_PROXY -u SOCKS_PROXY -u SOCKS5_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u all_proxy -u socks_proxy -u socks5_proxy npx -y cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:3000 --protocol http2 --no-autoupdate"
scripts.tunnel: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u ALL_PROXY -u SOCKS_PROXY -u SOCKS5_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u all_proxy -u socks_proxy -u socks5_proxy npx -y cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:3000 --protocol http2 --no-autoupdate
scripts.phone:prod: npm run build && concurrently -k -n APP,TUNNEL -c blue,green "npm run start:lan" "npm run tunnel"
